html:
We are delighted to present an extraordinary inclusion in our collection – the magnificent 2018 86’ Monte Carlo Yachts, elegantly positioned in the lively waters of Miami, Florida. This exceptional vessel is presently open for acquisition under the guidance of our esteemed broker, Ralph Navarro.

This 2018 Monte Carlo Yacht is a testament to impeccable Italian style, standing as a shining example of the boatyard’s unwavering vision and distinctive aesthetic. Measuring 86 feet, it embodies a commitment to excellence, featuring five distinct layouts meticulously crafted through the industry’s most innovative patented production process. The MCY 86 exudes an unparalleled design, characterized by a regal personality that unfolds within its spacious guest areas. Setting new standards with unprecedented levels of equipment, this yacht boasts decors and furnishings sourced from the pinnacle of craftsmanship in both Made in Italy and France.

This beautiful Monte Carlo Yacht presents a luxurious living experience with 4 staterooms and 4.5 heads, complemented by 2 crew cabins and a head. Step aboard and discover the magnificence of its accommodations – a Master stateroom with a King Bed and En-suite heads and shower, 2 x VIP Staterooms with Queen Beds and En-suite heads and showers, a Guest Stateroom with a Queen Bed and En-suite head and shower, and a convenient Day Head.

Under the guidance of Ralph Navarro, this meticulously listed 86′ Monte Carlo Yacht beckons those seeking an elevated standard of maritime luxury. Join us on a journey where sophistication meets precision, and this yacht stands as a testament to unparalleled design and opulence in the heart of Miami’s waters.

Specifications:

  • Beam: 21’ 2
  • Cabins: 4
  • Heads: 6
  • Hull: Fiberglass
  • Cruising Speed: 24kn
  • Max Speed: 29kn
